description:
After migration readiness ITM-0006 completes, build existing SCR observable-boot reset module against supplied platform kernel archive under var/. Consume canonical src/scr_reset_monitor/scr_reset_monitor.c and Makefile with exact approved hashes, preserved vendor inputs, working managed LETS compiler and independently verified migration handoff. ITM-0006 uniquely owns legacy workspace archival/retirement, relevant source import, compiler-preflight prerequisite fix and final readiness; this item does not duplicate that work. Actual rebuild outcome: two independent clean vendor-tree builds with byte-identical scr_reset_monitor.ko, input/compiler/config/source/artifact hashes, commands/logs and static ELF, release/vermagic, relocation and exported-symbol evidence. Preserve original var bytes/metadata, archived history, package/hardware evidence, active shared locks and image quarantine. State archived build #4 versus prior hardware #5 and compiler differences without inferring running-kernel compatibility. No package/image install, quarantine recovery, hardware access, module load, reboot, reset-cause change or legacy REQ resumption.

User migration-before-rebuild ruling supersedes old dependency/ownership assumptions. ITM-0001 remains outside migration chain and depends on ITM-0006. Existing unapproved plan r1 is historical and does not match new ownership/source handoff; do not approve or execute it. ITM-0006 must prepare fresh independently checked replacement plan using canonical paths and migration results, without prior approval inference. Explicit developer approval of current replacement plan is required before scheduling/build. Exact-revision SHOW approval remains separate after validation/QA. This amendment is scope/dependency reconciliation only, not implementation or plan approval.
